purpose: Narrow provenance correction to the canonical Market Navigator catalog. The evidence pipeline applies these replacements before acquisition and publishes the resulting effective catalog.

tenYear.description: Market yield on U.S. Treasury securities at ten-year constant maturity, aligned with the canonical 2Y and 30Y Treasury source family.
tenYear.provenance_note: Canonicalized from Yahoo ^TNX to FRED DGS10 so 2Y, 10Y and 30Y share one Treasury source family.

bootstrap_archive.provider: FRED historical snapshot via Internet Archive
bootstrap_archive.reason: Starting in April 2026 FRED/ICE exposes only a rolling three-year window for this ICE BofA series. The archived FRED CSV restores older canonical observations while live FRED remains authoritative for current updates.

dxy.description: ICE U.S. Dollar Index fixed-basket market measure used as an observable currency-strength proxy.
